data.one_liner: Streamlined golden testing tool for Flutter with local and CI-safe output support
data.what_it_does: Alchemist simplifies writing and executing golden tests in Flutter by providing declarative test scenarios and groupings. It distinguishes between local human-readable golden tests and cross-platform CI tests that use obscured text and the Ahem font to avoid font rendering discrepancies across operating systems. It also includes configurable diff thresholds, custom pumping behavior, and auto-sizing.
use_when: Writing visual regression and golden tests across multiple platforms without font mismatches failing CI
Organizing golden tests into structured groups and scenarios in a table format
Needing fine-grained control over golden test diff thresholds, theming, and gestures
avoid_when: You only require basic unit or widget testing without visual screenshot comparisons
Your project cannot use Dart 3.12+ or migrate to the standalone material_ui / cupertino_ui packages required by 0.15.0
strengths: Solves cross-platform font rendering issues on CI by rendering obscured text using the Ahem font
Provides clean `GoldenTestGroup` and `GoldenTestScenario` APIs to arrange multi-widget tests in a grid
Supports fine-grained configuration including pixel difference thresholds (`diffThreshold`) and custom pumping
weaknesses: Version 0.15.0 introduces a breaking change requiring standalone `material_ui`/`cupertino_ui` packages and minimum Flutter 3.44 / Dart 3.12
Generates separate sets of golden files for CI and local platforms, increasing repository file size
data.setup_notes: Requires running tests with `flutter test --update-goldens` to generate baseline golden images.
